note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are all described. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown to nearly black, fontanelle region slightly paler; nasus nearly black; antennae and pronotum brown; abdominal tergites light brown; legs and sternites straw. Body length 3.50–4.50 mm. Vertex with 1 pair of long setae, base of nasus with 1 pair of long setae, covered with minute hairs; pronotum covered with minute hairs throughout; each abdominal tergite with 1 long seta on each side and 1 pair at the middle, densely covered with minute hairs elsewhere. Head capsule subcircular (1.55–1.80 mm long including nasus, 0.95–1.15 mm long excluding nasus, 0.95–1.10 mm maximum width); in lateral view nearly straight dorsally, or very slightly incurved at the base of the nasus; nasus swelling absent; posterior margin rounded, sometimes shallowly concave. Nasus conical, short (0.55–0.75 mm long), with a few hairs at the tip; slightly longer than half to 3/4 of the head length (nasus length/head length index 0.55–0.79). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short black spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin rounded, without notch; posterior margin straight (0.20 mm long, 0.45–0.50 mm wide).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown to dark brown; antennae, postclypeus, labrum and legs straw; abdomen light brown dorsally, cream ventrally. Head sparsely covered with short hairs, abdomen densely hairy. Body length 4.0–4.5 mm. Head subquadrate (1.00 mm long, 1.03–1.08 mm wide); coronal suture distinct. Fontanelle plate slightly long, translucent. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus rather short, far less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly notched; posterior margin nearly straight; 0.20 mm long, 0.53 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown; postclypeus slightly paler than head; antennae and labrum brown; abdominal tergites dark brown, paler than head; legs and sternites light brown. Head and body densely covered with long and short hairs. Body length without wings 7.5–8.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and rounded (1.15–1.20 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.35–1.40 mm wide including eyes); slightly concave at the middle; coronal suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate long and narrow, translucent. Eyes broadly oval, distinctly protruding (0.50 mm maximum diameter, 0.42 mm minimum diameter). Ocelli oval to subcircular (0.18–0.20 mm long axis); adjacent to the compound eyes, almost touching the ocular sclerite (eye–ocellus distance 0.023–0.025 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segments 2 and 3 subequal. Postclypeus very weakly inflated, far less than half as long as wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (0.60–0.65 mm long, 1.10–1.15 mm wide); anterior part slightly raised; anterior margin nearly straight, without notch; posterior margin deeply incised at the middle. Wings grey; membrane covered with short hairs and fine non-stellate (4–7-armed) spinules; forewing 14.25–14.75 mm long, hindwing 13.10–13.60 mm long.
